name: codf
description: coDF — student utility converter. React/Vite frontend on Vercel, Node/Express API on Render.
//: Deliberately NOT an npm workspace. Each app keeps its own lockfile because each is built in isolation: Vercel builds apps/web with its root directory set there, and the Docker build context is apps/api. A hoisted root lockfile would leave both without one.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/api && npm install --prefix apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/api && npm run lint --prefix apps/web
